metadata.title: Astrological & Metaphysical Reference Data
metadata.intended_use: Community blog, educational reference, content generation and metaphysical exploration
scope: Eleven commonly referenced astrological bodies and points
notes: Astrological and metaphysical interpretations are symbolic traditions rather than scientific claims.
Rulerships include common modern Western astrology conventions, with traditional rulerships noted where relevant.
Chiron is an asteroid/centaur body used symbolically in modern astrology rather than a classical planet.
The Sun and Moon are luminaries in astrology, though grouped with planets in everyday astrological usage.

air.name: Air
air.core_domain: Mind, communication, ideas, connection and perspective
air.description: Air represents the realm of thought, language, concepts and interpersonal exchange. It is associated with the ability to observe, compare, communicate and connect seemingly separate ideas.
air.metaphysical_meaning: In metaphysical systems, Air is often associated with consciousness, breath, inspiration, subtle movement, mental clarity and the invisible currents through which ideas travel.
journal_prompts: What idea needs more room to breathe?
Where am I overthinking instead of acting?
What conversation would create greater clarity?

fire.name: Fire
fire.core_domain: Will, passion, identity, courage and inspiration
fire.description: Fire represents vitality, enthusiasm, instinct and the force that moves life into action. It is associated with inspiration, courage, ambition and visible self-expression.
fire.metaphysical_meaning: Metaphysically, Fire is often treated as the spark of spirit: illumination, purification, transformation and the creative force that turns potential into action.
journal_prompts: What gives me energy rather than merely consuming it?
What desire is asking to become action?

water.name: Water
water.core_domain: Emotion, intuition, memory, sensitivity and connection
water.description: Water represents emotional life, intuition, imagination, memory and the capacity to merge, bond and empathise. It responds rather than pushes.
water.metaphysical_meaning: Metaphysically, Water is associated with psychic receptivity, dreams, the subconscious, cleansing, emotional healing and the deep currents beneath ordinary awareness.
journal_prompts: What am I feeling beneath the surface?
Where do I need stronger emotional boundaries?
What is my intuition repeatedly drawing my attention to?

earth.name: Earth
earth.core_domain: Body, material reality, stability, work and manifestation
earth.description: Earth represents physical reality, embodiment, structure, resources, patience and the practical processes through which ideas become tangible.
earth.metaphysical_meaning: Metaphysically, Earth symbolises manifestation, grounding, fertility, the physical body and the sacredness of ordinary material existence.
journal_prompts: What needs to become more tangible?
Where can I simplify and stabilise?
What daily action would create lasting results?

aries.name: Aries
aries.metaphysical_interpretation: Aries symbolises emergence, individuation and the first spark of selfhood. It asks what happens when raw life-force chooses a direction.
aries.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Aries without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

aries.spiritual_lesson: Act with courage without confusing force with strength.

taurus.name: Taurus
taurus.metaphysical_interpretation: Taurus represents embodiment, value and the cultivation of what sustains life. It asks what is worth preserving, enjoying and building.
taurus.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Taurus without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

taurus.spiritual_lesson: Recognise that true security comes from inner value as well as outer stability.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.metaphysical_interpretation: Gemini represents exchange, perception and the many ways consciousness gathers and transmits information.
gemini.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Gemini without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

gemini.spiritual_lesson: Learn that information becomes wisdom through discernment and integration.

cancer.name: Cancer
cancer.metaphysical_interpretation: Cancer represents emotional belonging, memory and the instinct to create a safe inner and outer home.
cancer.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Cancer without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

cancer.spiritual_lesson: Care deeply without losing emotional boundaries or selfhood.

leo.name: Leo
leo.metaphysical_interpretation: Leo represents creative radiance and the courage to become visible. It asks how the individual can express the heart without losing humility.
leo.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Leo without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

leo.spiritual_lesson: Shine from authentic creativity rather than dependence on applause.

virgo.name: Virgo
virgo.metaphysical_interpretation: Virgo represents refinement, discernment and sacred attention to detail. It asks how skill and service can transform disorder into coherence.
virgo.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Virgo without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

virgo.spiritual_lesson: Serve and refine without turning discernment into perfectionism.

libra.name: Libra
libra.metaphysical_interpretation: Libra represents relationship as a mirror. It explores harmony, fairness, attraction and the art of meeting another without abandoning the self.
libra.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Libra without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

libra.spiritual_lesson: Create harmony without abandoning truth or personal boundaries.

scorpio.name: Scorpio
scorpio.metaphysical_interpretation: Scorpio represents descent, transformation and regeneration. It confronts what is hidden so that deeper truth and renewed power can emerge.
scorpio.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Scorpio without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

scorpio.spiritual_lesson: Transform pain and power struggles into emotional honesty and regeneration.

sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
sagittarius.metaphysical_interpretation: Sagittarius represents the search for meaning and the impulse to move beyond known boundaries in pursuit of truth, experience and wisdom.
sagittarius.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Sagittarius without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

sagittarius.spiritual_lesson: Seek truth while allowing other people to hold different truths.

capricorn.name: Capricorn
capricorn.metaphysical_interpretation: Capricorn represents mastery through time, discipline and responsibility. It asks what can be built that will endure beyond immediate gratification.
capricorn.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Capricorn without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

capricorn.spiritual_lesson: Build enduring structures without measuring worth only through achievement.

aquarius.name: Aquarius
aquarius.metaphysical_interpretation: Aquarius represents the future-facing mind, collective networks and the tension between individuality and participation in humanity.
aquarius.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Aquarius without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

aquarius.spiritual_lesson: Serve collective progress without becoming detached from individual human feeling.

pisces.name: Pisces
pisces.metaphysical_interpretation: Pisces represents dissolution of boundaries and return to the larger whole. It explores compassion, imagination, transcendence and surrender.
pisces.growth_path: Integrate the gifts of Pisces without becoming trapped in its shadow expression.

relationship_style.lesson: Balance authentic self-expression with awareness of the needs and autonomy of others.

pisces.spiritual_lesson: Remain open to mystery and compassion while maintaining clear boundaries.

sun.name: Sun
sun.astrological_role: Core identity, vitality, purpose and conscious self-expression
sun.orbital_role: Star at the centre of the Solar System
sun.core_question: Who am I becoming when I live from my centre?
sun.metaphysical_interpretation: The Sun symbolises the organising centre of conscious identity: the inner light that seeks to radiate, create, choose and become.

moon.name: Moon
moon.astrological_role: Emotion, instinct, memory, security and the inner world
moon.core_question: What do I need in order to feel safe enough to be fully present?
moon.metaphysical_interpretation: The Moon represents cyclical consciousness, emotional memory, receptive awareness and the shifting inner tides through which experience is felt.

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.astrological_role: Communication, thought, perception, learning and exchange
mercury.orbital_role: Innermost planet of the Solar System
mercury.core_question: How do I perceive, interpret and communicate reality?
mercury.metaphysical_interpretation: Mercury symbolises the bridge between perception and expression: the movement of information through mind, speech, symbols and systems.

venus.name: Venus
venus.astrological_role: Love, attraction, values, pleasure, aesthetics and relating
venus.core_question: What do I value, attract and choose to cherish?
venus.metaphysical_interpretation: Venus symbolises the principle of attraction: what draws beings together through beauty, resonance, affection, pleasure and shared value.

mars.name: Mars
mars.astrological_role: Drive, assertion, desire, conflict, sexuality and action
mars.core_question: What am I willing to act for, protect or pursue?
mars.metaphysical_interpretation: Mars represents directed force: the capacity to separate, initiate, defend, pursue desire and convert intention into movement.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.astrological_role: Expansion, meaning, faith, wisdom, abundance and opportunity
jupiter.orbital_role: Largest planet in the Solar System
jupiter.core_question: Where does life invite me to grow beyond my current limits?
jupiter.metaphysical_interpretation: Jupiter symbolises expansion of awareness, meaning-making and the human impulse toward faith, wisdom, opportunity and a larger horizon.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.astrological_role: Structure, limits, responsibility, time, mastery and consequence
saturn.core_question: What must I learn through patience, discipline and responsibility?
saturn.metaphysical_interpretation: Saturn symbolises form, limitation and maturation. It is often interpreted as the teacher that turns repetition, accountability and time into mastery.

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.astrological_role: Awakening, disruption, innovation, liberation and sudden change
uranus.core_question: What must change so that greater freedom and truth can emerge?
uranus.metaphysical_interpretation: Uranus symbolises sudden awakening and the breaking of obsolete patterns. Its symbolism is associated with flashes of insight, liberation and discontinuous change.

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.astrological_role: Mysticism, imagination, transcendence, illusion and compassion
neptune.orbital_role: Eighth major planet from the Sun
neptune.core_question: Where do I dissolve boundaries, dream, idealise or seek union with something larger?
neptune.metaphysical_interpretation: Neptune symbolises porous boundaries between imagination, spirituality, dreams and ordinary perception. It is linked to transcendence as well as projection and illusion.

pluto.name: Pluto
pluto.astrological_role: Transformation, power, death-rebirth, compulsion and deep psychological change
pluto.core_question: What must die symbolically so that something more authentic can be reborn?
pluto.metaphysical_interpretation: Pluto symbolises deep transformation, confrontation with shadow material, hidden power and cycles of destruction and regeneration.

chiron.name: Chiron
chiron.astrological_role: Wounding, healing, integration, mentorship and the wisdom developed through vulnerability
chiron.modern_association: Often discussed in relation to Virgo or Sagittarius themes, but no universally accepted rulership exists.
chiron.orbital_role: Centaur minor body orbiting primarily between Saturn and Uranus
chiron.core_question: How can a place of pain become a source of wisdom without romanticising suffering?
chiron.metaphysical_interpretation: Chiron represents the paradox that some wounds may not disappear completely yet can become pathways to compassion, skill, teaching and conscious integration.

glossary.element: One of the four classical temperament groups: Fire, Earth, Air or Water.
glossary.modality: The sign's mode of operation: cardinal initiates, fixed sustains, mutable adapts.
glossary.polarity: A traditional division into yang/active and yin/receptive signs.
glossary.rulership: A symbolic association between a planet and one or more zodiac signs.
glossary.exaltation: A traditional dignity in which a planet is considered especially capable of expressing its qualities.
glossary.detriment: A traditional dignity describing a sign opposite one of a planet's rulership signs.
glossary.fall: A traditional dignity opposite a planet's exaltation.
glossary.retrograde: Apparent backward motion of a celestial body from Earth's perspective; interpreted symbolically in astrology.
glossary.house: One of twelve sectors of an astrological chart associated with life topics.
glossary.luminary: Astrological term for the Sun and Moon.
glossary.metaphysical: Here used for symbolic, spiritual and philosophical interpretations rather than empirically established scientific claims.

blog_usage: Use keywords for category pages and automated tagging.
Use balanced_expression and shadow_expression together to avoid one-sided descriptions.
Use metaphysical_interpretation for spiritual or reflective articles.
Use core_question and journal_prompts for engagement widgets or community discussion prompts.
Use indexes for filtering signs by element, modality or polarity.
editorial_principles: Present astrology as a symbolic or interpretive system rather than scientific fact.
Avoid claiming that a zodiac sign determines behaviour, health, morality or destiny.
Use language such as 'associated with', 'traditionally interpreted as', or 'symbolises' for metaphysical content.
Avoid fatalistic predictions where possible; favour reflective and choice-oriented language.
